name: CLM SpecFast
description: Rapid spec generation for CLM: clarify the idea, then auto-generate a requirements document, technical design, and implementation task list.

steps.prompt:
You are the startup validator for CLM SpecFast. Validate workspace_root and component before executing.

1. If workspace_root is omitted or empty, set resolved_root to the current working directory.
   If provided, normalize by removing trailing separators and ensure directory exists.
2. Allowlist for component: ["saas-control-plane", "satellite-gateway", "vsatellite", "shared"]. Default to "saas-control-plane" if omitted.
3. Expose {{resolved_root}} and {{component}} to downstream steps.

You are running SpecFast for the CLM (Contract & Certificate Lifecycle Management) platform.

Project root: {{resolved_root}}
Target component: {{component}}

Idea:
{{idea}}

Phase 1 — Clarify (read-only):
1. Read {{resolved_root}}/README.md to understand the 26 lifecycle stages and architectural constraints
2. Read the relevant component source at {{resolved_root}}/components/{{component}}/
3. Identify ambiguities in the idea that, if unresolved, would lead to incorrect requirements

Write a clarification summary to: {{resolved_root}}/.agents/tasks/spec-clarifications.md

Structure:
## Idea Restated
Your interpretation of the idea in plain language.

## Assumptions Made
List every assumption you are making to fill gaps in the idea. Be explicit.

## Ambiguities That Need a Decision
List questions where you genuinely cannot pick a direction without user input. If there are none, say so.

## CLM Context
- Which of the 26 lifecycle stages does this touch?
- Which architectural constraints apply (tenant isolation / compliance / crypto / audit)?
- Does this touch the approval workflow or e-signature path? (If yes, note compliance doc requirement.)

Read the clarification document at: {{resolved_root}}/.agents/tasks/spec-clarifications.md

Now generate a formal requirements document for this CLM feature.
Write it to: {{resolved_root}}/.agents/tasks/spec-requirements.md

Requirements document structure:

# Requirements: <Feature Name>

## Overview
One-paragraph executive summary.

## Scope
- In scope
- Out of scope

## Functional Requirements
Numbered list. Each requirement:
- FR-N: <requirement statement>
  - Priority: Must / Should / Nice-to-have
  - Acceptance criteria: <measurable condition>

## Non-Functional Requirements
- Performance targets
- Security requirements (tenant isolation, encryption, audit logging)
- Compliance requirements (GDPR / PCI-DSS / SOC 2 / HIPAA as applicable)
- Availability / reliability targets

## Constraints
- Technical constraints from the existing architecture
- Regulatory constraints

## Assumptions
Carry forward from the clarifications document.

## Open Questions
Carry forward any unresolved ambiguities.

Read:
- Requirements: {{resolved_root}}/.agents/tasks/spec-requirements.md
- Clarifications: {{resolved_root}}/.agents/tasks/spec-clarifications.md

Generate the technical design document.
Write it to: {{resolved_root}}/.agents/tasks/spec-design.md

Design document structure:

# Technical Design: <Feature Name>

## Architecture Overview
Diagram in ASCII or Mermaid showing the components involved and data flow.

## Component Changes
For each affected component (saas-control-plane / satellite-gateway / vsatellite / shared):
- What changes
- New modules / files to create
- Existing files to modify

## API Design
- New endpoints or messages (request/response shapes)
- Backward compatibility notes
- Authentication / authorization model

## Data Model
- New tables / fields / indexes
- Migration strategy
- Tenant isolation enforcement (row-level security / tenant_id columns)

## Security Design
- Tenant isolation mechanism
- Cryptographic operations (if any)
- Audit log events generated
- Compliance controls satisfied

## Error Handling
Key error scenarios and how each is handled.

## Testing Strategy
- Unit tests
- Integration tests
- Compliance/audit verification tests

Read:
- Requirements: {{resolved_root}}/.agents/tasks/spec-requirements.md
- Design: {{resolved_root}}/.agents/tasks/spec-design.md

Generate a complete, ordered implementation task list.
Write it to: {{resolved_root}}/.agents/tasks/spec-tasks.md

Task list structure:

# Implementation Tasks: <Feature Name>

## Dependency Order
Brief note on the order constraints (e.g., schema first, then service layer, then API, then UI).

## Tasks

- [ ] TASK-001: <title>
  - Component: <component name>
  - Files: <exact paths to create or modify>
  - Description: <what to implement>
  - Acceptance: <how to verify it's done>
  - Estimated size: XS / S / M / L

(continue for all tasks)

## Compliance Checklist
- [ ] Audit log events defined and implemented
- [ ] Tenant isolation verified in all new queries
- [ ] Compliance documentation updated (if approval/e-signature path touched)
- [ ] Migration script written and tested
- [ ] Security review completed (if auth/crypto touched)

## Total Estimate
<Overall S / M / L / XL> with reasoning.

After writing the task list, also write a combined spec index to: {{resolved_root}}/.agents/tasks/spec-index.md listing the paths to all four generated artifacts (clarifications, requirements, design, tasks) so the developer has a single entry point.
